name: Professional Teeth Whitening
teaser: Brighter, whiter teeth — professionally done for lasting, safe results.
overview: Professional teeth whitening delivers noticeably brighter results than over-the-counter products, in a fraction of the time. The procedure uses a carefully controlled concentration of whitening agent to lift stains caused by coffee, tea, wine, or simply the natural aging of tooth enamel.
Unlike store-bought strips, professional whitening is tailored to your teeth and supervised by a dental professional — ensuring both effectiveness and the safety of your enamel and gums.

whatToExpect.title: Pre-Whitening Exam
whatToExpect.body: We'll examine your teeth to confirm you're a good candidate for whitening and address any existing sensitivity concerns before starting.

whatToExpect.title: Whitening Treatment
whatToExpect.body: A professional-grade whitening gel is applied to your teeth. We'll protect your gums throughout the process for a comfortable experience.

whatToExpect.title: Results & Maintenance Tips
whatToExpect.body: You'll leave with a noticeably brighter smile. We'll give you tips on maintaining your results and discuss any touch-up options.

faqs.question: How white can my teeth get?
faqs.answer: Results vary depending on the type and severity of staining, and your natural tooth shade. Most patients see a significant improvement — your dentist will give you a realistic expectation at your consultation.

faqs.question: Is teeth whitening safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, when done professionally. The procedure is carefully monitored to protect your enamel and gums. Some patients experience temporary sensitivity, which subsides within a day or two.

faqs.question: How long do whitening results last?
faqs.answer: With proper maintenance — limiting staining foods and beverages, and brushing regularly — results can last 1–3 years. Periodic touch-ups can extend them further.
